colorPairs.name: Good mark on its own surface
Attention mark on its own surface
Failed mark on its own surface

meta.purpose: Meta line, chip, column header, hint. 12px is the floor.

row.purpose: Table row, button label, field. Weight 500 marks the identifier in the first column, and nothing else.

prose.purpose: Sentences: a notice, a dialog body.

fonts.name: ui
fonts.purpose: Every word on screen that is not a machine value.

fonts.name: mono
fonts.purpose: A machine value only: version, tag, path, ref, commit hash. It takes the size of its slot.

row.purpose: Table row, table header, list row, navigation item. 20px line plus 6px above and below.

control-in-row.purpose: Button, field or checkbox inside a row. WCAG 2.2 2.5.8 floor, never smaller.

control.purpose: Button, field or checkbox in a band, a dialog or a form.

measure.purpose: The one number a screen is checked against.

tight.purpose: An icon beside a word, the inside of a chip.

inline.purpose: Between two controls side by side.

cell.purpose: Left and right in a table cell, inside a card.

panel.purpose: The inner edge of a panel or a dialog.

section.purpose: Between two blocks on a screen.

page.purpose: The outer edge of the screen.

float.purpose: Menu, popover, dialog. Floating layers only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The one shadow. Menu, popover and dialog, always with a 1px gray-7 border. The page itself uses borders and tonal steps, never a shadow.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border change on hover and focus; a control revealed on row hover.

motion.name: float-in
motion.purpose: Opacity of everything that floats, the backdrop included: the row menu, a popover, the hover card, a dialog, the selection bar. Opacity only, no scale.

motion.name: float-out
motion.purpose: The same layers on the way out.

motion.name: loop
motion.reducedMotion: Stands still; the skeleton stays as flat blocks.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: The spinner in a button, in the Re-read control and in a row's menu icon, infinite.
motion.reducedMotion: Keeps turning: it is the only visible sign of busy.

motion.name: hover-open
motion.purpose: A wait, not motion: the pointer rests this long before a hover card opens. Keyboard focus opens it at once.

motion.name: hover-close
motion.purpose: A wait, not motion: the pointer leaves for this long before the hover card closes. Entering the card cancels the close.

motion.name: gate-arrival
motion.value: whole sequence within 600ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), on opacity, translateY, scaleX and blur, once on mount
motion.purpose: The connect gate's welcome only (ADR-0022), and the one exception to the entrance-animation ban. Its rule is gray, not amber: amber means Attention and never decorates (ADR-0033).

narrative.northStar: A cockpit you can read at a glance and steer without guessing: neutral surfaces, one meaning per mark, and every word readable in both themes.
narrative.overview: Maestro is a dense local cockpit for an AI agent setup. Its design system is a neutral Radix-grammar palette in a light and a dark theme, Geist type, one fixed density and one frame per screen (ADR-0033). Colour is the third cue behind the word and the glyph, never the first. The chain is design.json to tokens.css to DESIGN.md: this file is the source, tokens.css ships, DESIGN.md is regenerated and never hand-edited.
keyCharacteristics: Radix Colors 3.0.0 values, unchanged, with light and dark on the same step numbers.
The neutral role is named gray and its values are slate; five scales in total and no sixth.
Seventeen documented foreground and background pairs are the allowlist, each measured at its own floor in both themes.
Geist and Geist Mono, five sizes in rem, weights 400, 500 and 600.
One fixed density: every row is 32px, and the Inventory shows at least 18 rows at 1440x900.
Only what floats moves, by opacity alone.
rules: Take every colour, size and spacing from a token. A mock is never the source.
Give a column, a badge, a glyph and a word one meaning on every screen.
Show every status as a word plus its family's glyph. Colour is the third cue.
Use blue only for focus, selection and links, and keep the primary action neutral: gray 12 fill, gray 11 on hover.
Make the destructive button outlined: red 11 text on a red 7 border, on gray 1 or 2.
Give fields and checkboxes a gray 9 border; button borders and separators stay on gray 7.
Put a link on gray 1 or 2 only.
Use Geist Mono for a machine value and nothing else: version, tag, path, ref, hash.
Keep a row to one line at 32px, and put no button in it.
Use the one shadow for a menu, a popover or a dialog, and nowhere else.
dos: Add a new pairing to design.json and the contrast test before a component uses it.
Write sizes in rem so 200% zoom keeps working.
Mark the identifier in a row with weight 500, and let colour carry the rest of the rank.
Right-align a count and give it tabular figures.
Fade a floating layer in at 300ms and out at 200ms, on opacity.
Keep the spinner turning under reduced motion; it is the only sign of busy.
Stamp data-theme on the root before first paint, so the wrong theme never flashes.
Set color-scheme beside data-theme, so native controls follow the theme.
Use a tonal step or a border for a surface on the page.
Read the step's task from its number: 1 canvas, 2 panel, 3 control, 4 hover, 5 selected, 6 separator, 7 border, 8 border-hover, 9 solid, 10 solid-hover, 11 muted text, 12 text.
donts: Never let colour alone carry a status: no Radix good and fail pair stays apart under deuteranopia.
Never fill a button with blue: white on blue 9 is about 3:1.
Never let amber decorate. It means Attention.
Never use a status mark on step 9: in light, green 9 on green 3 is 2.82.
Never put a link on gray 3 or darker.
Never write a colour, a size or a spacing as a literal value in a component.
Never set a font size in px; the ramp is in rem.
Never animate anything that does not float, and never with scale or overshoot.
Never add an entrance animation; the connect gate is the one exception (ADR-0022).
Never stack shadow levels: there is one shadow.
Never give a primitive type a hue. It is its plain word in gray 11.
Never edit tokens.css or DESIGN.md by hand; change design.json and regenerate.
